scripts.build:web-deps: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:pro
scripts.dev: npm run build:web-deps && npm --workspace apps/web run dev
scripts.dev:emulator: npm run build:web-deps && npm --workspace apps/web run dev:emulator
scripts.emulators: npm --workspace @grids/firebase-functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project grids-one --only ${FIREBASE_EMULATORS:-auth,firestore,functions,storage}
scripts.emulators:import: npm --workspace @grids/firebase-functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project grids-one --only ${FIREBASE_EMULATORS:-auth,firestore,functions,storage} --import=./emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.lint:web-deps: npm --workspace @grids/contracts run lint && npm --workspace @grids/pro run lint
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web-deps && npm --workspace apps/web run lint && npm --workspace @grids/firebase-functions run lint
scripts.test: npm --workspace @grids/pro run test && npm --workspace apps/web run test:run && npm --workspace @grids/firebase-functions run test
scripts.type-check:web-deps: npm --workspace @grids/contracts run type-check && npm --workspace @grids/pro run type-check
scripts.type-check: npm run build:web-deps && npm --workspace apps/web run type-check && npm --workspace @grids/firebase-functions run type-check
scripts.suite:full: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run type-check && echo 'Success!'
